Container.Name: Delamain
Container.Overview: Delamain is a self-hosted voice companion for the drive, modeled on Delamain from Cyberpunk 2077. Open it in any browser, including the one on your car's Android Auto display, press the mic and talk. It answers in a cloned Delamain voice (F5-TTS) with a lip-synced face, and over 600 pre-recorded lines answer everyday messages instantly. Ten personality cores, from the original to the rogue cabs (Wellsprings, The Glen, Northside and more), each with its own temperament, face tint and voice. It searches the web through SearXNG, reads spoken news bulletins, gives weather and drive times, speaks reminders, keeps notes and long-term memory in your Obsidian vault, and hands navigation to your phone's map app. Works with any OpenAI-compatible LLM that supports tool calling (llama.cpp, vLLM, Halogen). Everything else is set up from the web UI: choose a password on first visit and connect your LLM under Settings, Integrations. The voice model and lip-synced clips download by themselves on the first start.
Container.Requires: An OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint with tool calling, reachable from the container. Nothing else to supply: on the first start the container downloads the F5-TTS voice model (about 1.3 GB) and the lip-synced clips (about 240 MB) into App Data, then records its fixed lines in the background. Open the Web UI, choose a password, and set the LLM under Settings, Integrations (or fill in the variables below). A GPU is recommended for real-time speech; CPU works but is slower on replies that are not pre-recorded.

Config.Name: Backend API Port
Config.Description: Web UI, API and WebSocket port.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Database, settings saved from the web UI, recorded audio and the lip-synced clips (downloaded on first start). To clone another voice, put a 10-second WAV here and set DELAMAIN_REF_AUDIO to /app/data/its-name.wav.

Config.Name: F5-TTS Model Weights
Config.Description: F5-TTS model weights. Downloaded here automatically on the first start (about 1.3 GB).

Config.Name: Obsidian Vault (optional)
Config.Description: Optional: your Obsidian vault. Delamain keeps notes and long-term memory under Delamain/ in it. In Settings, Integrations, the vault folder is /vault.

Config.Name: LLM URL
Config.Description: Chat completions URL of your OpenAI-compatible LLM server (llama.cpp, vLLM, Halogen), e.g. http://192.168.1.x:8080/v1/chat/completions. Use the server's LAN IP, not localhost (that resolves inside the container). Can also be set in the web UI under Settings, Integrations.

Config.Name: LLM Model
Config.Description: Model id your LLM server serves (listed at its /v1/models). llama.cpp ignores it.

Config.Name: LLM Reasoning Effort
Config.Description: For reasoning models (Qwen, Halogen): set to none to turn thinking off so replies come quickly. Leave blank for other models.

Config.Name: Tools
Config.Description: Let the LLM call tools: web search, news, weather, drive times, Obsidian notes and memory. Needs a model with tool calling.

Config.Name: SearXNG URL
Config.Description: Optional: URL of a SearXNG instance for live web search (weather, traffic, places) and the news fallback. Example: http://192.168.1.x:8887/search

Config.Name: Lip-sync clips URL
Config.Description: Where the lip-synced clips are downloaded from on first start (and refreshed when the release changes). Empty to skip the download.

Config.Name: Allowed Origins
Config.Description: Only needed when another site calls this API (cross-origin). Opening the Web UI directly, on the LAN or through a reverse proxy or tunnel, works without it. Comma-separated, e.g. https://delamain.example.com

Config.Name: NVIDIA GPU (optional)
Config.Description: Set to 'all' to use an NVIDIA GPU for the voice. Requires the Nvidia-Driver plugin, and --runtime=nvidia in Extra Parameters (Advanced View). Leave blank for CPU only.
